+"""Load image references without making HTTP requests to user-supplied URLs."""
+
+import base64
+from urllib.parse import unquote, unquote_to_bytes
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+from app.services.storage import GCSStorage, storage
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(reference: str | None) -> bytes | None:
+    if not reference:
+        return None
+
+    try:
+        if reference.lower().startswith("data:image/"):
+            header, separator, payload = reference.partition(",")
+            if not separator:
+                return None
+            data = unquote_to_bytes(payload)
+            if header.lower().endswith(";base64"):
+                return base64.b64decode(data, validate=True)
+            return data
+
+        # Public storage URLs are aliases for keys in the configured bucket.
+        storage_hosts = [settings.STORAGE_HOST]
+        if isinstance(storage, GCSStorage):
+            storage_hosts.append(f"https://storage.googleapis.com/{storage.bucket_name}")
+
+        key = reference
+        for host in storage_hosts:
+            if host and reference.startswith(f"{host.rstrip('/')}/"):
+                path = reference[len(host.rstrip('/')) + 1:]
+                if "?" in path or "#" in path:
+                    return None
+                key = unquote(path, errors="strict")
+                break
+
+        if ":" in key.split("/", 1)[0] or "\\" in key:
+            return None
+        if any(ord(char) < 32 or ord(char) == 127 for char in key):
+            return None
+        if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in key.split("/")):
+            return None
+
+        return storage.download_image(key)
+    except Exception:
+        logger.warning("Failed to load image reference")
+        return None

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+from PIL import Image
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+from app.services.reference_board import download_image
+from app.services.storage import storage
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def no_http(monkeypatch):
+    request = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("Unexpected HTTP request"))
+    monkeypatch.setattr("requests.sessions.Session.request", request)
+    yield
+    request.assert_not_called()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def images():
+    with io.BytesIO() as buffer:
+        Image.new("RGB", (2, 3), "white").save(buffer, format="PNG")
+        png = buffer.getvalue()
+    key = storage.upload_image(png, "cuts", "test")
+    inline = "data:image/png;base64," + base64.b64encode(png).decode("ascii")
+    return png, key, f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{key}", inline
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("reference", [
+    "http://internal.invalid/image.png",
+    "https://external.invalid/image.png",
+    "//external.invalid/image.png",
+    f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}-other/image.png",
+    f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/../image.png",
+    "data:image/png;base64,!",
+])
+def test_generation_loaders_skip_unsupported_references(reference, no_http, monkeypatch):
+    download = Mock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(storage, "download_image", download)
+    assert BaseAIService()._download_image(reference) is None
+    assert download_image(reference) is None
+    download.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_generation_loaders_read_storage_and_inline_images(images, no_http):
+    png, *references = images
+    for reference in references:
+        assert BaseAIService()._download_image(reference) == png
+        image = download_image(reference)
+        assert image is not None
+        assert image.size == (2, 3)
+
+
